title: Create: Craft 'n Extras
description: Create: Craft 'n Extras is a lightweight, vanilla-friendly addon for the Create mod that bridges the gap between raw materials and your building palette. It eliminates tedious crafting table grid-spamming by introducing logical, high-efficiency mechanica
body:
# Create: Craft N' Stuff

Tired of jumping between crafting tables and Create machinery just to get basic building blocks? Create: Practical Recipes bridges the gap by adding logical, mechanical recipes for items you already use every day.

No more arbitrary crafting grids—just pure, automated efficiency using the factory mechanics you love.

What It Adds
This addon introduces intuitive Create mod recipes for vanilla and modded items that were previously un-craftable through automation.

Haunting: Haunt normal Glass to create Tinted Glass.

Pressing: Run any Wood Plank through a Mechanical Press to yield Trapdoors.

Cutting: Use the Mechanical Saw to get precise, higher-yield outputs for wood and stone utilities.

Milling & Crushing: Expanded compatibility for recycling blocks back into their base components.

Why Install It?
Vanilla Friendly: Every recipe feels like it should have been in the base mod from the start.

Automation Ready: Fully compatible with item transport, funnels, and belts for seamless factory integration.

Balanced Yields: Designed to respect game balance while rewarding you for automating your production lines.
